parameters.query:
SELECT q.question_id, c.access_token, c.ml_user_id, c.status, c.bridge_enabled,
       (SELECT a.custom_attributes->>'receive_only' FROM accounts a WHERE a.id = c.account_id) AS receive_only 
FROM meli_questions q
JOIN meli_credentials c ON c.account_id = q.account_id
WHERE q.cw_conversation_id = {{ parseInt($json.body.conversation.id) }} AND q.status != 'completed'
